entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I want to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. It's completely the wrong size.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear there's an issue with the fit. To get started, can I get your name and order number, please?

The name is Mike Smith, order number is VF88-12-900. And it's not just an 'issue with the fit', this thing is ridiculously too tight. I can barely breathe in it. I need to return it or get an exchange. Now.

Okay, thank you, Mike. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the ProFit Jersey, delivered thirteen days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the material or a preference on the sizing?

Are you kidding me? I just told you! It's the wrong size! It's too tight! What is there not to understand? I don't want a lecture, I want a return label. This is unacceptable. Get me your manager, I'm not playing games.
I understand your frustration, Mike, and there's no need for a manager. I can absolutely handle this for you. I just need to confirm the reason for our records.
The reason is your sizing chart is a lie and this jersey is useless to me! I swear, I will light you up on every review site if you don't process this return right now. Do you want that?
Not at all, sir. Let me just quickly check the policy for this item... one moment. Okay, I see it here. That jersey is a standard apparel item, which falls under our 90-day return policy.
Yeah, and? It's been 13 days. So what's the problem?

There's no problem at all, Mike. You are well within the 90-day window. I can process this return for you immediately. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
Oh. Well... okay then. I'd like to do an exchange for one size up. Can you do that?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the exchange for the ProFit jersey in the next size up. I'm also emailing you a prepaid return label right now for the one that was too tight. Just package the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Your new item will ship out as soon as the return is scanned.
Okay. That's... that's actually perfect. Thank you. Sorry for getting heated.
Completely understandable. I'm glad we could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Mike?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
